author: Praxis I
title: Analysis: Label-Free Diagnostics of Global Residualization (EtC-BRBG) via Unsupervised Clusters
abstract: We run a test-only analysis that builds EtC embedding and unsupervised Leiden clusters, then measures batch predictability (R²) in graph-PC space before and after global per-PC residualization, summarized per cluster. This provides label-free evidence for why global residualization is effective.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

import json
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
from praxis.analysis_global_resid import analyze_label_free

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    sc.settings.verbosity = 0
    summary = analyze_label_free(adata,
                                 n_pcs_emb=60, n_pcs_graph=50,
                                 gamma_max=0.74, lam_r2=0.9,
                                 l2=1e-3, leiden_res=1.0, random_state=0)
    print("=== Label-free Global Residualization Diagnostics ===")
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    return "analysis_done"
